## 📄 YouTube Description  

What if one of the most powerful wellness ingredients on earth was formed over 15,000 years ago and is still transforming skin, inflammation, and spa experiences today?

In this episode of **The Aesthetic and Wellness Edge**, host **Bethany Gifford** sits down with **Michael Beresford**, founder of **Moors Spa**, a globally recognized eco-luxury skincare and spa brand inspired by Austria’s ancient healing moor mud.

Michael shares his incredible journey from UK marketing to pioneering one of the cleanest, most environmentally responsible professional skincare lines in the world. This conversation dives deep into the science, history, and innovation behind moor mud, a substance used for centuries across Europe in medical spa settings to support inflammation, skin health, and overall wellness.

You will learn how Moors Spa became a leader in:
• 100 percent natural, CertClean-certified skincare  
• Petroleum-free, toxin-free formulations  
• Biodegradable and microplastic-free packaging  
• Award-winning mud and mineral therapies  
• Turnkey spa business models without franchise royalties  
• Integrated hydrotherapy, steam, red light, and infrared spa systems  

Michael also reveals how European medical spa traditions differ from the U.S., why clean beauty standards matter more than ever, and how spa owners can future-proof their businesses through sustainability, innovation, and experience-based treatments.

This episode is a must-watch for:
• Spa owners and wellness entrepreneurs  
• Estheticians and massage therapists  
• Clean beauty advocates  
• Med spa founders exploring expansion  
• Anyone passionate about natural healing and sustainable luxury  

🔗 Learn more about Moors Spa: https://www.moorspa.com  
📩 Contact Michael directly: michael@moorspa.com  

🎧 Subscribe to *The Aesthetic and Wellness Edge* for conversations at the intersection of aesthetics, longevity, innovation, and conscious business growth.

If this episode inspired you, please like, subscribe, leave a review, and share it with a fellow spa or wellness professional.
